notes.title: Changes made before the first release
notes.content: [p][b]Oh, hey! I'm so excited about uploading and releasing the first release of the game, but first I need to fix some bugs and add some features so I make sure it's fully playable and everyone can enjoy it. I'm doing the best that I can since I'm just a single developer, but it seems it's going well. :)[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]There are tons of things that changed in the game...[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]About the map: [/b]I had to put the map together, so now it has a forest, a club, a farm, and a city. After the release of the game, I want to make a lake or beach too.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628289/8ae72a8e817974c82eb184d788b424cc0a4bfa4b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]About physics: [/b]There are some problems yet that I need to fix. I know that I need collision. I think [b]it's the hardest thing in the game[/b]. For now, I added jiggle physics only in female bits. The hard thing is collision with other avatars and walls since each avatar needs a physics asset for that, and it will take a long time to make it if so.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628289/89cba920888d80a076c6449a20d12ba947adcd5e.png"][/img][/p][p][b]About graphics:[/b] The materials [b]are optimized[/b] and in the settings menu can be fully customizable so they can run on different computers, from bad to powerful GPUs, but I recommend a powerful one for rendering real fur once the release is done. For the security of the user, it will have a shortcut key to reset everything.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628289/314c646c482eda894a31db54747dc1ae7f77e7b5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]About animations:[/b] Now they will [b]run smoothly[/b] thanks to the "state machine." I just need to fix small bugs, but it seems good to me. There are some features like X-Ray that I will implement once bugs get fixed. After all bugs and features are done, I will add more animations and also at least 5 cuddle animations.[/p][p][/p][p][b]About character customization:[/b] Each time is now more customizable, and my idea is also that the user can change colors or upload/edit the skin.[/p][p][/p][p][b]About mods:[/b] I added a node that will make sure that the mods folder exists in the game so you can add/edit/share JSON files that can be character settings and, in the future, will be animations. I want to have steam workshop in the game for this so everyone can enjoy any mod that any author publishes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628289/abc560cd0051a8b01fa780078cf4012aa48eb343.png"][/img][/p][p][b]About VR, Steam Deck, and Lovense:[/b] Sadly I can't implement it yet. I don't have the hardware to work on it, so I need to first release the game, and then I will check again if I can have the hardware.[/p][p][/p][p][b]About feral players:[/b] yes… there is a cave with rugs in the map. :)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628289/88d0ef2690501865d5b9baf66be49ea1bc47d62c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]I will continue working on this game. I appreciate your support!! [/b][/p]
